verdict.rationale: Clerky's own docs say the platform handles hiring employees, consultants, and advisors and issuing stock options, including adopting a stock plan. A community user confirms a post-incorporation hiring package. However, offer letters and confidentiality/IP agreements are never named as specific documents, so only option grants are explicitly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of offer-letter and confidentiality/IP (CIIAA) document types, detail on the option-grant workflow, hands-on corroboration of running hiring paperwork end to end.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can run hiring and equity paperwork — offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, and option grants — through the platform

citations.quote: Hire employees, consultants, and advisors, and issue stock or stock options as equity compensation.
Adopt a stock plan to easily issue restricted stock or stock options to employees, consultants, and advisors.
Clerky gives me management tools (including the post-incorporation package: Fundraising, Hiring and Maintenance)
